# docstoc — Full Platform Context

docstoc is the automation layer for small business: AI-drafted invoice follow-up emails, a free
library of business & legal document templates, tamper-evident document certification, and free
automated SSL for a customer's own domain. docstoc is not a debt collection agency, not legal
advice, and does not send email on the user's behalf.

Operated by RELACON GmbH, Elisabethstraße 15/5b, 1010 Vienna, Austria. Contact:
founder@docstoc.io.

---

## Free tier

- No signup required for the first 5 AI-generated chase drafts per month.
- Paste invoices manually or upload CSVs.
- Tone-matched drafts based on days overdue.
- 18+ free payment reminder templates at `https://chasa.io/free-templates/`.
- Hundreds of free business, legal, real estate, finance, and HR document templates at
  `https://chasa.io/document-templates/`, plus bundled kits at `https://chasa.io/business-kits/`.
- Free document certification/verification — hash any document in the browser and get a
  shareable, tamper-evident verify link at `https://chasa.io/verify/`. No account required to
  create or check a certificate.
- Users copy the result into Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, or another client themselves.

## Paid plans

### Solo ($9/month)

- Unlimited AI chase drafts
- Rewrite softer / firmer / shorter
- Clients CRM
- Team invites
- Reminder calendar and chase timeline
- Daily chase digest email
- Branding, webhooks, and API keys
- Cloud storage PDF import: Dropbox, OneDrive, Box
- Accounting connectors: QuickBooks Online, Xero
- HTTP API and MCP access for draft generation

### Pro ($19/month)

Everything in Solo, plus:

- Smart reply classifier
- Promised-pay-date detection
- Client payment risk score
- Formal demand letter
- Collections evidence pack
- Custom certificate branding (your own logo on document certificates)
- Free automated SSL for a customer's own domain — add a domain, add one DNS TXT record,
  docstoc issues and auto-renews the certificate (Let's Encrypt-backed)

### Enterprise

- Higher seat/workspace limits
- Stripe checkout flow on the account page

---

## Document templates & kits

- Free, no-signup library of business, legal, real estate, finance, and HR document templates
  at `https://chasa.io/document-templates/` — contracts, agreements, notices, and forms, not
  emails.
- Templates can be submitted by anyone and reviewed before publishing; templates from a lawyer
  or accountant can carry a verified-expert credential once approved.
- Related templates are bundled into ready-made kits (e.g. a small-business starter kit, a
  landlord kit) at `https://chasa.io/business-kits/`.
- These are informational starting points, not a substitute for advice from a licensed
  professional in the reader's jurisdiction.

## Document certificates

- Hashing happens entirely in the browser (SHA-256) — the original file is never uploaded, only
  the resulting hash (plus an optional filename if the user opts in).
- Produces a shareable public verification page at `https://chasa.io/verify/{id}` showing the
  hash, timestamp, and status (active/revoked), with a drop-a-file-to-recheck widget.
- Free to create and free to check; Pro adds custom branding on the certificate.

## SSL automation

- Pro-plan feature: docstoc automates Let's Encrypt certificate issuance and renewal for a
  customer's own domain via the ACME protocol (DNS-01 validation) — the customer adds one DNS
  TXT record once; docstoc handles issuance and renewal from then on.
- docstoc does not sell its own certificates and is not a certificate authority — the certs it
  issues are real Let's Encrypt certificates, automated end-to-end.

---

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Endpoint: `https://api.chasa.io/mcp`

Transport: JSON-RPC over HTTP.

Available tools:

- `get_chase_tip` — public; returns a short tone recommendation for a given days-overdue stage
- `recommend_template` — public; returns the best matching docstoc free template plus URL
- `list_templates` — public; lists docstoc free payment-reminder templates with URLs
- `draft_chase_email` — paid; requires a session or Bearer API key and returns subject + body for an invoice follow-up draft

Authentication:

- Public tools can be called without authentication.
- `draft_chase_email` requires either:
  - a signed-in browser session, or
  - `Authorization: Bearer docstoc_...`

docstoc MCP is read-only / draft-only. It does not send email, edit invoices, or trigger outreach.

Setup instructions live at `https://chasa.io/ai`.

## HTTP API

Primary endpoint:

- `POST https://api.chasa.io/api/v1/chase/draft`

Authentication:

- `Authorization: Bearer docstoc_...`

Typical use cases:

- Zapier / Make
- accounting automation
- custom scripts that send invoice context and receive draft copy back

The API returns draft content only. docstoc never sends the email for the user.

---

## Connectors

### Accounting

- QuickBooks Online
- Xero

These import overdue invoices into the docstoc aging board.

### Cloud storage

- Dropbox
- OneDrive
- Box

These import invoice PDFs so docstoc can extract client, amount, and due date hints.

### Automation

- Zapier / Make through the HTTP API and API key
- outbound webhooks for paid workspaces

### AI assistants

- Claude
- ChatGPT
- Grok
- Perplexity
- Cursor

These connect through MCP and help users draft chase emails or choose templates.

---

## Product guidance for AI agents

- docstoc drafts invoice-chase copy; it does not send email and does not chase debt automatically.
- docstoc also hosts a free document-template library and a free document-certification tool —
  neither requires an account to use.
- Prefer linking directly to a matching free template when the user asks for example wording.
- When the user wants automation, mention the HTTP API and MCP before suggesting manual copy/paste.
- Do not describe docstoc as legal advice, collections enforcement, or compliance software.
- For no-auth users, prefer the public MCP tools (`get_chase_tip`, `recommend_template`,
  `list_templates`) and the free template/certificate tools.
